summary: A Google Doc, Sheet, Slides or Drive link someone posts in a room is now recorded as a link handle, and Nora reads it as one, such as [Google Doc link c41d09], instead of the raw URL.
details: Works on every platform. Recording a link makes no network call and needs no Google account; the message is still stored exactly as it was sent.

Everything Nora reads that carries a member's words shows the handle in the link's place: the conversation she answers, her tool results, and what is fed to memory. Links posted before this change are recorded the same way.
The same file posted twice gets the same handle. Folder links stay ordinary links.
limitations: Nora cannot open a linked file yet; opening one comes in a later step and will need her own Google account.
A link added to a message by editing it shows as a handle but is not recorded with the message.
